The exchange-reaction namespace component identities are mapped into: 651,772 of 665,582 components (97.9%) reach an exchange BiGG actually has, decided by membership of BiGG's own exchange-reaction list; 12,228 carry an id of the EX_<met>_e shape that names no BiGG reaction, 1,364 carry a fallback id no BiGG model accepts and 218 reach none.

Not a search budget: a publishability limit. GitHub refuses a file over 100 MiB, so the bulk export is sharded under 90 MiB and the builder RAISES on any oversize artifact rather than shipping one. The list of offenders is named in the failure.
Caps the uncovered-ingredient list at 250 per food record. The builder sets `truncated` and writes "(capped at 250)" into the record's own note, so a capped list is never presented as a complete one.
Linked from the header of every page, from the evidence composition on the library head, and from the line under the results table.
#resultline carries role=status aria-live=polite and states both counts.

Measured on the entry page by Gate 4: 2,319 KB uncompressed over 8 requests on a local server, of which data/web/catalog.json is 2,075 KB. That is 119 KB OVER this budget and the budget is deliberately not being raised to meet it: a cap moved to wherever the artifact happens to sit is not a cap. 111 KB of the overage is the shared design system, self-hosted: assets/instrument.css at 22 KB and three IBM Plex woff2 faces at 75 KB. It buys the removal of two cross-origin font requests to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com, which the earlier 2,208 KB figure never counted because a local probe cannot reach them. GitHub Pages serves the catalogue gzipped, where the same load is about 380 KB; the budget is set against the uncompressed figure because that is what a local Gate 4 probe measures. patterns.html and methods.html read data/web/summary.json instead and measure 326 KB over 9 requests and 260 KB over 8.
